channel.title: Query Optimization on The Art of PostgreSQL
channel.description: Recent content in Query Optimization on The Art of PostgreSQL

item.title: PostgreSQL Index Types
item.description: B-tree is the default and the right answer most of the time. But GiST, GIN, and BRIN exist because some questions a sorted tree simply can’t answer.

item.title: How the PostgreSQL Planner Picks a Plan
item.description: The planner assigns a numeric cost to every possible execution strategy and picks the cheapest. Understanding how it calculates cost explains why it sometimes picks what looks like the wrong plan.

item.title: Predicate Pushdown: Filter Close to the Scan
item.description: PostgreSQL automatically moves WHERE conditions as close to the underlying scan as possible. Understanding when it can’t — and why — is a key query-rewriting skill.
